content.text: Frame 3How does someone standing at Frame 3 go to where Frame 1's camera position? Choices:  A. go straight, up the stairs, then turn right towards the white platform. B. go straight, up the stairs and then go inside of the first room on the left. C. go straight, turn right and then go straight. D. go straight ahead, then turn right through the end of the corridor. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
